name: Omarchy Vitals
author: osesantos
description: System monitor for the Omarchy bar — CPU, memory, disk, network, and sensors, modelled on exelban/stats

barWidget.description: One bar entry per metric. Pick a module (cpu, memory, disk, network, sensors) and a widget style.

schema.label: Module
schema.description: Which system metric this bar entry monitors.

schema.label: Widget style
schema.description: How the metric is drawn in the bar. Not every style suits every module.

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often this module is sampled.
